title: Anonymous online survey on substance use in Augsburg
summary: The use of addictive substances can affect physical and mental health as well as overall well-being and poses a challenge to the healthcare system. To date, there is little up-to-date information available for the city of Augsburg on how widespread substance use is and how it relates to the health of the population. The aim of the study is to better understand the relationship between substance use and health in Augsburg. The study will examine what types of substances are used, how frequently this occurs, and what health effects are associated with it. An anonymous online questionnaire is being used for this purpose. Participants answer questions about their health status, physical and mental health issues, their well-being, and their substance use patterns. Reasons for use and potential adverse effects are also recorded. No personally identifiable information is stored, so no conclusions can be drawn about individual participants.
conditions: Mental and behavioural disorders due to psychoactive substance use

interventions.name: Population-based sample of adults from Augsburg. One-time data collection using a cross-sectional design via an anonymous online questionnaire on substance use and health administered through SoSci Survey (approx. 10–20 minutes).
